fields.name: required string, stored uppercase
fields.amount: required positive number entered in the current display currency. The field shows that currency's symbol. The ledger amount is the canonical USD equivalent.
fields.currency: The field uses the display currency. Save stores entered_amount, entered_currency, canonical_amount, canonical_currency USD, conversion_rate_used, and conversion_timestamp. Original entered values stay on the row.
fields.type: EXPENSE or INCOME. Mutually exclusive. Default EXPENSE.
fields.account_or_source: CHECKING or CARD. Mutually exclusive. Default CHECKING.

validation: SAVE stays disabled until name, amount, type, and account are present and the amount is a positive number.
selected_states: aria-pressed and emerald fill on the active type and account.
save_enabled_condition: name.trim && amount matches digits with optional cents && amount > 0 && type && account
activity_update: The new row is prepended to the shared ledger and appears on Activity.
today_update: Today reads the same ledger. Cash and safe-to-spend move with the added amount. Moved shows the newest rows.
